pair_protocol.negative_construction: after splitting; 50% father-vs-mother within-family negatives; remaining negatives cross-family but remain within the same split
pair_protocol.triadic_negatives: replace each family's child with a child from another family on the same side of the outer split

reconstruction_assumptions.formulation_1: five seeded 80/20 group holdouts on TSKinFace, adapting the historical FIW five-seed protocol
reconstruction_assumptions.formulation_2: five matched TSKinFace folds, not the historical 20 folds across four corpora
reconstruction_assumptions.formulations_3_and_8: same singleton-set density feature and control on TSKinFace; reported as one operationalization, not independent evidence
reconstruction_assumptions.formulation_4: amplitude-encoded normalized embeddings, alpha sweep over [0,1], relative phase sweep over [0,2pi), phase-gain feature
reconstruction_assumptions.formulation_5: training-fold-fitted PCA and standardization to four Ry angles; fixed Ry/CNOT-chain state; entropy of a two-qubit reduced density matrix; local Rz gates omitted because they do not change bipartite entropy
reconstruction_assumptions.formulation_6: two-qubit symmetric amplitude state; four rank-one orthogonal POVM effects; outcomes 0 and 1 map to kin; 16-parameter four-logit linear control
reconstruction_assumptions.formulation_7: current symmetric hybrid classifier; four-qubit reduced state purity penalty versus batch decorrelation penalty; both weighted by lambda=0.01
reconstruction_assumptions.formulation_9: triad features augmented by maximum, mean, standard deviation, and gain over the zero-phase amplitude-encoded interference sweep

config.statistical_caveat: Five folds partition the same family pool. Paired t tests and fold-based intervals are exploratory. Family-cluster bootstrap intervals use fixed out-of-fold predictions and condition on the fitted models; they do not capture training-set variability. Multiplicity adjustment does not make folds independent population samples.

bootstrap_analysis.method: CI-only paired family-cluster bootstrap within each fold; equal-weight mean of fold-wise AUC differences; no cross-fold score pooling

formulation_2.interpretation: Exploratory paired-fold test; folds partition the same identity pool.

family_cluster_bootstrap.pair_weight: product of endpoint-family multiplicities; within-family pairs use one family multiplicity
family_cluster_bootstrap.fold_aggregation: equal-weight mean of fold-wise paired AUC differences; scores from different fold models are never pooled
family_cluster_bootstrap.interpretation: Paired family-cluster bootstrap on fixed out-of-fold predictions; conditions on the five fitted models and is exploratory.
